claude_proposed_widenings.name: create_object.conditional_size_by_material
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spell imposes a smaller maxSize (medium) for metal/stone/mineral materials vs. large for everything else. create_object has only one maxSize field with no material-conditional branching. Two separate direct phases can't express a material-conditional choice because there's no phase-level predicate on the attached object's material.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If you're working with metal, stone, or another mineral substance, however, the fabricated object can be no larger than Medium (contained within a 5-foot Cube).

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ObjectMaterial.stone_or_mineral
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: ObjectFilter.material only covers 'metal' and 'flammable'. Fabricate's size restriction applies to stone and other minerals, which has no matching ObjectMaterial variant.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: create_object.proficiency_gate
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spell forbids creating high-skill items (weapons, armor) unless the caster has proficiency with the relevant Artisan's Tools. No predicate gate on create_object can express a caster-proficiency check.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You also can't use it to create items that require a high degree of skill—such as weapons and armor—unless you have proficiency with the type of Artisan's Tools used to craft such objects.
